description: A namespaced type constructor call is an error
notes: The native syntax spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens, so ns::list(string) would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go), and getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reports ns::list as an invalid type constructor.
reference_error: Keyword "ns::list" is not a valid type constructor
